title: Pulchinenoside E2: A dual-functional STAT3 and autophagy inhibitor with potent anti-metastatic activity in triple-negative breast cancer.
authors: Zheng, Dongning; Shu, Junfang; Gao, Benjian; Yu, Hailong; Liu, Kemeng; Zheng, Meiling; Liu, Xiaoyan; Chen, Gang; Lin, Yangyi; Li, Qinlian; Sun, Yuhang; Zheng, Yuhang; Li, Bo; Yang, Xiaoli; Wang, Kai
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 研究天然化合物PSE2通过抑制STAT3信号和自噬发挥抗三阴性乳腺癌转移作用，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA结合，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) lacks effective therapeutic targets and exhibits high metastatic potential, resulting in poor prognosis. Both STAT3 signaling and pro-survival autophagy are well-established as critical drivers of TNBC metastasis, yet existing therapeutic approaches primarily focus on single-target inhibition. Pulchinenoside E2 (PSE2), a natural compound isolated from Pulsatilla chinensis, has demonstrated anti-proliferative effects on breast cancer cells. However, its effect on TNBC metastasis and whether it acts concurrently with these two pathways remain unclear. PURPOSE: To identify the key molecular targets of PSE2 and elucidate its unique mechanisms in suppressing TNBC metastasis. METHODS: The anti-migratory and anti-invasive effects of PSE2 on multiple TNBC cell lines were assessed using Transwell assays. Network pharmacology analysis was used to identify overlapping genes and core targets associated with PSE2 and TNBC metastasis. STAT3 was identified as a key target through Western blotting, RNA interference, and Transwell experiments. PSE2-STAT3 interactions were investigated via molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations, and the cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA). In vitro studies with HS-578T and MDA-MB-231 cells evaluated the effects of PSE2 on STAT3 and JAK2 phosphorylation, STAT3 nuclear and mitochondrial functions, autophagy, and the interplay between STAT3 inhibition and autophagic regulation. In vivo, TNBC metastasis mouse models were used to assess PSE2's effects on hepatic and pulmonary metastases. Pharmacokinetic analysis evaluated the compound's clinical translational potential. RESULTS: PSE2 selectively inhibited invasion and migration in TNBC cells. Network analysis identified 41 overlapping genes and 11 core targets, among which STAT3 emerged as a critical mediator of PSE2's anti-metastatic effects. STAT3 demonstrated the lowest binding free energy to PSE2, with binding confirmed by molecular dynamics simulations and CETSA. PSE2 suppressed p-JAK2 (Tyr(1007/1008)) and p-STAT3 (Tyr(705) and Ser(727)), impaired STAT3 nuclear transcriptional activity, and inhibited STAT3-dependent mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation. Additionally, PSE2 blocked autophagic flux by impairing lysosomal proteolytic activity, promoting degradation of mature tissue proteases, and disrupting lysosomal acidity, independent of STAT3. Concurrent inhibition of STAT3 phosphorylation and autophagy synergistically enhanced suppression of TNBC cell migration and invasion. In vivo, PSE2 markedly reduced hepatic and pulmonary metastases and exhibited prolonged retention and slower clearance in mice. CONCLUSIONS: PSE2 functions as a dual inhibitor of STAT3 signaling and autophagy, exerting potent anti-metastatic effects in TNBC. Its mechanism involves suppression of STAT3 phosphorylation and induction of lysosomal dysfunction. These findings highlight PSE2 as a promising candidate for the treatment of TNBC metastasis.
abstract_zh: 背景：三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）缺乏有效治疗靶点且具有高转移潜能，导致预后不良。STAT3信号通路和促生存自噬均已被确认为TNBC转移的关键驱动因素，然而现有治疗方法主要集中于单靶点抑制。白头翁皂苷E2（PSE2）是从白头翁（Pulsatilla chinensis）中分离的天然化合物，已显示出对乳腺癌细胞的抗增殖作用。然而，其对TNBC转移的影响以及是否同时作用于这两条通路仍不清楚。目的：鉴定PSE2的关键分子靶点，并阐明其抑制TNBC转移的独特机制。方法：使用Transwell实验评估PSE2对多种TNBC细胞系的抗迁移和抗侵袭作用。通过网络药理学分析鉴定与PSE2和TNBC转移相关的重叠基因及核心靶点。通过Western blotting、RNA干扰和Transwell实验将STAT3鉴定为关键靶点。通过分子对接、分子动力学模拟和细胞热位移分析（CETSA）研究PSE2-STAT3相互作用。使用HS-578T和MDA-MB-231细胞进行体外研究，评估PSE2对STAT3和JAK2磷酸化、STAT3核和线粒体功能、自噬以及STAT3抑制与自噬调控之间相互作用的影响。在体内，使用TNBC转移小鼠模型评估PSE2对肝转移和肺转移的作用。药代动力学分析评估该化合物的临床转化潜力。结果：PSE2选择性抑制TNBC细胞的侵袭和迁移。网络分析鉴定出41个重叠基因和11个核心靶点，其中STAT3成为PSE2抗转移效应的关键介质。STAT3与PSE2的结合自由能最低，并通过分子动力学模拟和CETSA确认了结合。PSE2抑制p-JAK2（Tyr(1007/1008)）和p-STAT3（Tyr(705)和Ser(727)），损害STAT3核转录活性，并抑制STAT3依赖性线粒体氧化磷酸化。此外，PSE2通过损害溶酶体蛋白水解活性、促进成熟组织蛋白酶降解以及破坏溶酶体酸性来阻断自噬流，这一过程不依赖于STAT3。STAT3磷酸化和自噬的同时抑制协同增强了TNBC细胞迁移和侵袭的抑制效果。在体内，PSE2显著减少肝转移和肺转移，并在小鼠中表现出延长滞留和较慢清除的特性。结论：PSE2作为STAT3信号和自噬的双重抑制剂，在TNBC中发挥强效抗转移作用。其机制涉及抑制STAT3磷酸化和诱导溶酶体功能障碍。这些发现凸显了PSE2作为治疗TNBC转移的有前景候选药物。
